brief: Owner: remove the Jellyfin comparisons from CI and the repo. D-110 retired the differential tier and the Jellyfin schema check, but no open task did it and both still run in every queue run. Owner answered the lead's recommendation (remove those now, keep the jellyfin-web gate until the cutover): "Okay, continue."
tradeoff: Given up: the automated check that jellyscale's answers match Jellyfin 12.4's and its schema, which third-party Jellyfin apps relied on. No viewer of Octave or jellyfin-web loses anything: the jellyfin-web gate and every behaviour test stay.
serves: PRODUCT.md, Quality bar: "Behaviour is decided from the viewer's outcome and written into the contract before it is built."
entry: JS-221 (after JS-220) retires the differential tier, the Jellyfin schema check and the tooling only they use; behaviour tests that use a captured shape are kept or rewritten, never deleted; the jellyfin-web gate stays until JS-194. For JS-216: nothing checks Jellyfin's shape any more, so the contract's casing is chosen for Octave's apps alone, never to match Jellyfin.
